subject: general
question: The ratio of a father's age to his son's age is 3 ∶ 2 The product of the numbers representing their age is 486. The ratio of their ages after 5 years will be:
solution:
Given:

The ratio of the ages of father to his son = 3: 2

Product of their ages = 486

Formula Used:

The concept used is the simple calculations

Calculations:

The ratio of the ages of father to his son = 3: 2

⇒ Let the age of the father = 3x

⇒ The age of the son = 2x

⇒ Product of their ages = 486

⇒ (3x)(2x) = 486

⇒ x² = 81

⇒ x = 9

⇒ The age of father = 3x = 3 x 9 = 27 years

⇒ The age of son = 2x = 2 x 9 = 18 years

The age of father and son after 5 years will be

⇒ Father age = 27 + 5 = 32 years

⇒ Son age = 18 + 5 = 23

⇒ The ratio of the ages of father to son = Father age: Son age = 32: 23

⇒ **Hence, The ratio of father age to son age after 5 years is 32:23**
